entities.summary: Shukhrat Safin (b. 1970-04-03, Samarkand) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Samarkand and Uzbekistan. Known in the fields of uzbekistan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
